atr.source: Computed here (Wilder ATR-14) from an 83-session Kraken XXBTZUSD daily series through the in-progress 2026-08-03 UTC candle. Math: TR = max(H-L, |H-Cprev|, |L-Cprev|), then ATR = (ATRprev x 13 + TR) / 14, seeded on a 14-bar simple average of true range. The daily endpoint returned a CLEAN, self-consistent series this run — the in-progress 2026-08-03 bar reads O 63,500.0 / H 63,980.1 / L 62,218.4 / C 63,888.3 and every one of those four figures is corroborated by the independently-fetched 15m and 4h series, so unlike the 10:20 pass no daily bars had to be rebuilt. ATR has ticked DOWN slightly from that pass, 1,644.01 to 1,637.30 (-0.4%), the first contraction in three reports, because further travel inside today's bar now adds less than the bars rolling out of the window. At 2.56% of spot a normal day covers about $1,637. Relevance to the trade: spot to the 62,284.3 invalidation is 1,604 points, or 0.98 of a daily ATR — for the first time in this sequence the core has a FULL average day of room before invalidation, where this morning it had 0.19.

calibration.rollingRecord: The 06:45 COT morning report called range with a bullish tilt at 33/41/26, and for the second report in a row the tilt was right AND the desk acted on it. Morning published exactly one constructive signal — a bullish 15m RSI divergence between the 07:00Z close of 62,600.3 at RSI 28.60 and the 11:45Z close of 62,582.6 at RSI 42.43 — described it as worth a small spot tranche rather than a trend call, and the wallet added on it at 62,582.6. Spot is now 63,888.3, so that tranche is +2.09% in six hours. Neither morning level fired: the 62,284 reduce held with a session low of 62,363.8, 79.5 points of clearance, and the 62,205 add-trigger was never tagged. The 10:20 midday pass then trimmed part of that add at 63,714.7 into the 63,904-64,241 supply shelf; price has since gone sideways rather than up, at 63,888.3 now, so the trim neither helped nor hurt — it bought optionality at the cost of about 25 points of upside, which is a fair price for optionality.
calibration.note: Two calibration lessons from this session, and they point in opposite directions, which is why both are worth writing down. FIRST, the one that is now proven twice: a small, specific, single-timeframe signal sized honestly beats waiting for a strong multi-timeframe signal that never arrives. Morning had a bearish daily, a bearish 4H histogram and a hostile ETF tape against one lone bullish 15m divergence, and the correct action was to buy a small tranche anyway. SECOND, the one this run adds: the same 15m timeframe that gave the buy signal at RSI 42 has now given a bearish divergence at RSI 69, and the desk should respect its own instrument symmetrically. Having taken the 15m seriously on the way in, it does not get to ignore the 15m on the way out. That is the reasoning behind holding rather than adding here, and it is a deliberate correction to the pattern where this desk acts on constructive signals and rationalises away cautionary ones.
